recognize_zh: 四格低倍 IHC：瀰漫單一的腫瘤細胞在 CD4（A）、CD8（B）、CD20（C）皆為陰性，只有零星背景細胞著色，而 Ki-67（D）幾乎所有核都呈棕色陽性；CD4/CD8 雙陰性加上極高增生指數，符合 T 淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Four low-power immunohistochemistry panels of a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate effacing the tissue
CD4 (A): tumor cells negative; only scattered positive background cells (histiocytes/T helper cells)
CD8 (B): tumor cells negative with rare positive cells
CD20 (C): tumor cells negative; scattered small positive background B cells
Ki-67 (D): nuclear staining in the large majority of tumor cells (estimated >90%)
Hematoxylin counterstain shows a vague nodular/lobulated pattern with thin intervening septa
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stains at low power show a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate that is negative for CD4 and CD8, with only scattered positive background cells, and negative for CD20, which highlights only rare residual small B cells. Ki-67 labels the great majority of tumor nuclei, indicating a very high proliferation index. The CD4/CD8 double-negative phenotype is typical of an immature T-cell population. In combination with T-lineage markers (cytoplasmic CD3) and TdT or CD34 positivity, the findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic lymphoma; these confirmatory stains are not shown in this image.

ddx.vs: Burkitt also has Ki-67 near 100% but is CD20+/CD10+/BCL6+, TdT-negative, with a starry-sky pattern and MYC rearrangement.
Blastoid MCL is CD20+ and cyclin D1+, TdT-negative, whereas this infiltrate is CD20-negative.
Myeloid sarcoma is also CD20-negative with high Ki-67 but expresses MPO, CD33, CD117, or lysozyme and lacks cytoplasmic CD3.

ddx.dx: Thymoma (type B) with immature T cells
ddx.vs: Thymoma contains cytokeratin-positive epithelial network with polyclonal TdT+ thymocytes, typically CD4/CD8 double positive rather than double negative.
